derivation: One family (one_way_shear) carries every combination; the other five families hold one PASS verdict of ratio 0.4 per footing. Order: FAIL, else ERROR, else NEEDS_ENGINEER, else NOT_APPLICABLE, else PASS. J1: PASS 0.5 gives PASS. J2: PASS and NOT_APPLICABLE give NOT_APPLICABLE. J3: NOT_APPLICABLE and NEEDS_ENGINEER give NEEDS_ENGINEER. J4: NEEDS_ENGINEER and ERROR give ERROR. J5: ERROR and FAIL 1.2 give FAIL. J6: PASS 0.9, FAIL 1.5 and ERROR give FAIL. The verdicts of different footings are interleaved in the list; they are grouped by subject id. Displayed ratio: the ratio of the verdict that carries governing (the pack marks the largest PASS or FAIL ratio of a subject): J1 0.5, J2 0.5, J5 1.2, J6 1.5; J3 and J4 have no PASS or FAIL verdict and so no governing one: null. Closure (all six PASS: passed; any FAIL: failing; else needs_engineer): J1 passed; J2, J3, J4 needs_engineer; J5, J6 failing. No bound flag is set and every size is from the calc, so the state flags are false.
